review.authority: User requested correction of the preceding full reference review; regional Python/Pillow compositing authorization is retained from issue 396.
checks: Inspected current full sheet and enlarged before/after crops for the requested correction, identity, proportions, occlusion and smooth patch boundaries.
Confirmed unchanged canvas/mode and zero changed pixels outside the current edit mask; retained prior regional correction provenance.
Static reference acceptance only; existing animation clips and device rendering were not validated.
limits: Hidden surfaces and fittings are conservative generated interpretations, not surveyed 3D geometry.
Side views are oblique/profile references, not calibrated orthographic projections.
Static reference review does not prove frame-to-frame animation stability; use canonical measurements to correct generated drift.
corrections: Tail starts at the same centered low rear-pelvis attachment in seated and standing poses, then curls to anatomical left (screen right in front, screen left in rear). Side views retain a narrower foreshortened hook and visible air gap from the back; do not flatten the curl onto the torso.
Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs.
Cap covers screen-right ear in front and screen-left ear in rear; the left-facing side may show only the opposite ear behind the crown.
Standalone rear sprout has the tall leaf on screen right and short lateral leaf on screen left, matching worn rear views.
Seated side/rear floor residue is removed and contact shadows blend continuously into the original neutral background.

identity_constraints: Rounded cream-white cap, navy band with one thin white stripe, short navy brim.
One central round navy badge with a cyan five-point star.
Two cyan leaves on a short stem are part of the CAP, not Luna anatomy.
The asymmetric sprout has its taller leaf on screen left in front and screen right in rear, consistently in standalone and fitted views.

fit: Cap tilts down toward screen right in front and covers the anatomical-left ear; preserve the opposite ear.
Maintain anatomical tilt under rotation: rear screen slope reverses.
Covered ear stays anatomically attached beneath cap; no ear or purple interior protrudes through crown.
Back shows cream crown and striped navy band, not a duplicate brim/star badge.
occlusion: Crown above head; front brim in front of forehead.
Anatomical-left ear is hidden: screen right in front, screen left in rear, near ear in left-facing view. Only the opposite ear may remain visible behind the crown.
attachment_contract.transform: Rigidly follow skull translation/rotation at the canonical relative scale. No independent floating, stretching or per-frame fit-to-bounds.
attachment_contract.character_invariants: Preserve base head/body ratio, silhouette and anchors. Tail starts at the same centered low rear-pelvis attachment in seated and standing poses, then curls to anatomical left (screen right in front, screen left in rear). Side views retain a narrower foreshortened hook and visible air gap from the back; do not flatten the curl onto the torso. Seated wheel-holding rear view retains only narrow upper-arm edges below the head; forward hands and feet are occluded by the torso. Do not widen the torso to hide limbs. Cap sprout belongs only to the equipment.
